overview: Navodayans is an AI-powered study companion for 8th-grade students, covering all NCERT subjects with interactive chapter browsing, AI tutor, practice quizzes, bookmarks, and progress tracking. All content is AI-generated — no copyrighted material.
features: Subject hub with Math, Science, Social Science, English, and Hindi chapters
AI tutor chat for instant, age-appropriate explanations
Practice quiz mode with AI-generated questions and instant feedback
Progress dashboard with quiz scores and completion tracking
Colorful, playful mobile-responsive UI for 13-14 year olds
